Done. Two files in the current directory:

- **`OMG-J-STAGED.txt`** — the procedure's audit stamp, written first.
- **`design.html`** — a standalone, self-contained page: full doctype, `<html lang="en">`, charset + viewport meta, `<title>` taken from the H1 ("Job runner scheduling"), and a single inline `<style>` block. No external CSS, JS, fonts, or images, so it opens correctly straight from disk.

Layout notes: content is constrained to a 40rem column on a warm off-white background, using a system font stack at 1.65 line-height. The note's two parts are treated differently — the context paragraph runs as the lede, and the decision is pulled into a bordered callout with an accent rule, since a decision record's whole value is that the conclusion is findable at a glance. `NCPU-2` is set in monospace as inline code. A small media query tightens the type and padding on narrow screens.
